status: P4 complete; no promotion (Brier gate failed, coverage-flag AUROC failed)
amendments: Extraction collects Pass/Fail only in v2: cause categories and the four diagnostic Booleans are not prompted. The 17 seeded pilot causes remain legacy metadata.
The three seeded verification rows labelled nli_failure under v1 were mapped to verifier_error (evidence was present and clear in all three); the mapping is recorded in queue_seed.json.

The 237-row human pass was replaced by materialized LLM proposals at the user's direction. Only the 37 seeded pilot rows are human labels. The resulting claim is 'LLM-proposed labels with pilot-estimated noise', upgraded to 'human-audited on a 40-row sample' only if the optional audit is completed.
Labelling is no longer a gate for P2-P4: calibration and coverage use FEVER val/test probabilities and the frozen detector, not these taxonomy labels.

baseline.summary: v1 pilot verdict committed; v1 artifacts frozen

human_review.label_policy: Use the seeded human verdict when present; otherwise materialize the LLM proposal. LLM rows are silver labels, never labelled human.

label_noise_pilot.note: Pilot is a validation sample, not a prevalence sample. v2 category agreement is 0.75 after splitting nli_failure; the v1 report's 0.80 used the old categories.

human_audit.design: 40 rows, disjoint from the 37 human pilot rows: 10 Pass / 10 Fail extraction proposals + 20 verification rows stratified by proposal category
human_audit.claim_if_completed: LLM-proposed labels, human-audited on a 40-row stratified sample
human_audit.claim_if_skipped: LLM-proposed labels with pilot-estimated label noise

verification_changes: ambiguous_evidence retained as a first-class category
taxonomy_v2.extraction_causes: not collected in v2; v1 pilot causes retained as legacy metadata; not gated
taxonomy_v2.note: Category counts are descriptive; only Pass/Fail gates the human-label check.

test_budget.rule: Thresholds and policy are frozen on val before each pass; no iteration on test. Log every pass, including reruns forced by bugs.

calibration.fallback: If calibration misses the val gate, ship raw scores labelled uncalibrated and skip the confidence UI.

fallback.trigger: no operating point meets both constraints at coverage >= 0.50
fallback.rule: choose the max-coverage point meeting the verifiable target and pre-register the overall precision it yields

coverage_flag.target: strict retrieval failure: at least one claim lacks its full gold evidence set in top-5
coverage_flag.features: serving-available only; no gold evidence or labels
coverage_flag.fallback: If the gate misses, omit the flag from serving and report it as a diagnostic only.

promotion_gates.macro_f1_note: non-inferiority vs v1 0.702; the default v2 verdict path is unchanged
promotion_gates.brier: no worse than uncalibrated on test
promotion_gates.coverage_flag: meets its utility gate or is omitted

notes: v1 artifacts are read-only; v2 writes only under experiments/v2/ and docs/.
The 40 pilot rows overlap the full queues; 37 had Pass/Fail verdicts and stay human labels. The other 237 rows are LLM-proposed silver labels; three of those are the pilot rows that lacked a verdict.
Do not describe the 237 materialized rows as human annotations. Report the 37-row pilot noise estimate and, if available, the 40-row audit.
Overall answered precision is dominated by NEI claims in v1 (322 NEI claims answered, all wrong); NEI coverage is reported separately rather than folded into one selective-risk number.
The retrieval variant is a stretch, triggered only if the calibrated system misses a promotion gate and time remains.
